title: Place a server-managed component on SCH or PCB
summary: Downloads a component's SchLib and PcbLib over HTTP, places the symbol or footprint from those files, and stamps the placed symbol with server metadata as parameters plus a current footprint model link. Includes a local stub server to try it.
phrasings: place a component from a SchLib file at a point
place a footprint from a PcbLib file on a board
download a library and place a part
add parameters to a placed schematic component
link a footprint model to a schematic symbol

commands.name: PlaceSchComponent
commands.description: Download a component's libraries and place its symbol
commands.params: Url=<server URL>|SessionId=<session>|ComponentId=<id> (all three required unless StartTestServer is running and Url is omitted)|Out=<cache folder> (default <temp>\ComponentManager)|X=<mil>|Y=<mil> (default 1000,1000)|Interactive (menu default; refused on the pipe)|Part=<n> (optional)|Timeout=<s> (default 30)

commands.name: PlacePcbComponent
commands.description: Download a component's PcbLib and place its footprint
commands.params: Url=<server URL>|SessionId=<session>|ComponentId=<id> (as PlaceSchComponent)|Out=<cache folder>|X=<mil>|Y=<mil> (from the board origin; default the centre of the board outline)|Interactive (menu default; refused on the pipe)|Timeout=<s>

commands.name: StartTestServer
commands.description: Start a local stub component server (test setup)
commands.params: SchLib=<full path>|PcbLib=<full path> (required)|LibRef=<symbol>|Footprint=<footprint> (default: from a component of the active sheet or board)|Id=<id> (default CM-TEST-1)|LibraryPath=<text> (default the SchLib file name)|FootprintPath=<text>|ComponentType=<text>|AssembleTech=<text>|Params=Name:Type:Value;... |Port=<n> (default 0 = any free port)

commands.name: StopTestServer
commands.description: Stop the local stub component server
